probes.name: two-signatures
probes.method: Two real off-chain signatures; no transaction signing

scope: Real registered Safe keys sign the actual pinned Safe digest; public execTransaction eth_call succeeds. Runtime guard checks canonical NFT-only mint/pause/unpause call, zero CALL/value/refunds, exact sorted three ECDSA approvals, current Safe nonce/authority and code, outer executor/from/to/bytes/nonce and 120-second monotonic deadline. Negative copies and clock changes stay in memory. The software timeout is not expiry enforced by the Safe contract; all demo signers are on one Mac.
